# It's eternity in there!

Meet the **ОЗТ Eternal** — an RPG-themed modpack mostly focused on exploration and immersion, initially created for a local community.

## What is this about?

This modpack provides plenty of QoL, vanilla overhaul and world generation mods to make your worlds more lively and your advetures more immersive.

New mechanics are also included, such as spellcasting, technology and skill trees.

## Setting up and gameplay notes
- This modpack uses [CraftPresence](https://modrinth.com/mod/DFqQfIBR). Make sure to set up nice instance name in your launcher! (Check out the [Prism Launcher](https://prismlauncher.org))

- Your launcher doesn't support Modrinth modpacks? There are also [ZIP download](https://fabulously-optimized.github.io/mrpack-to-zip/) links in the version changelogs.

- This modpack embeds some edited mod configs. However, some client-side mod configs are not embedded, such as [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/1bokaNcj) and [Embeddium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sk9rgfiA).\
  **Make sure to check your game options and keybinds before playing!**
  
  <small>(You can always edit mod configs by yourself, but it may break some things or even completely ruin your game. Only do this if you know what you are doing)</small>
 
- This modpack is highly recommended to play with [Visual Traveler's Titles](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/Z6cnZeGU) resourcepack.
